acceptance: A hosted `@slow` or `@plan` oracle review through the gateway completes, with its longest silent stretch measured from the gateway log, or a reproducible failure is recorded with its cause.
If silent stretches past the idle limit fail, the gateway or reviewer setting is changed and the fix verified the same way.

In scope: #3565, #3572, #3573, #3574, #3576, the unopened scope-path, evidence-exempt and redaction branches, and any other PR touching _project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/, _project/scripts/oracle_review_check.py, _project/scripts/soundness_merge_digest.py, scripts/pr_arm.py or .github/workflows/oracle-*.yml. description: Once PR #3296 moves the reviewer onto the scoped auth-gateway, every reviewer request streams through `omp auth-gateway serve` on the owner's Mac. The local test of that setup did not include a request with a long silent stretch. The gateway runs on Bun, whose server idle timeout is at most 255 seconds; the gateway's setting and its keepalive behaviour during provider silence were not checked. A high-effort `@slow` or `@plan` review can think longer than that before emitting output, so long reviews could fail as absent. Start after #3296 merges.
